action_instruction: Checking the Order OD1180 earned entry in coin history
intent: whether the coin history contains the Order OD1180 earned entry and its displayed coin amount

action_params.condition: The coin history lists an entry "Order OD1180 — earned" with "+48".
action_params.query: whether the coin history contains the Order OD1180 earned entry and its displayed coin amount

action_instruction: Checking the Redeemed on Nexa case entry in coin history
intent: whether the coin history contains the Redeemed on Nexa case entry and its displayed coin amount

action_params.condition: The coin history lists an entry "Redeemed on Nexa case" with "-200".
action_params.query: whether the coin history contains the Redeemed on Nexa case entry and its displayed coin amount

assertion_tree.description: the coin history lists an entry "Order OD1180 — earned" with "+48" and an entry "Redeemed on Nexa case" with "-200"

sub_results.description: The coin history lists an entry "Order OD1180 — earned" with "+48".
The coin history lists an entry "Redeemed on Nexa case" with "-200".

assertion_tree.verification: The current coin history lists both specified entries with their specified coin amounts.
